# A genuine Android key attestation chain, leaf first, base64 DER.
# Captured from an API-36 emulator by
# xkey-android AttestationCaptureTest.captureRealAttestationChain.
#
# challenge:     xkey-fixture-challenge
# securityLevel: software (an emulator has no TEE keymaster)
# rootOfTrust:   deviceLocked=false, verifiedBootState=2 (unverified)
# appId:         com.automatethethings.xkey.debug v1
#
# Kept because the hand-built fixtures could not distinguish a correct
# parser from an over-permissive one: they encoded RootOfTrust under
# context tag 0 while real devices use 704.
